content.value_statement: Empty merge fields and weak conditional rules can expose data or break email copy. This skill maps tags, defines fallbacks, and audits personalized content.
actual_capabilities: Maps personalization tags to supplied export columns and records field types.
Defines explicit fallbacks and shows how empty fields render.
Creates segment-based conditional rules with catch-all defaults.
Audits templates for blank fields, broken grammar, and dead branches.
Identifies fields that may expose sensitive PII and suggests coarser substitutes.
Checks personalized promotional claims against supplied approved wording.
limitations: Requires an existing email creative and an existing segment map or column list.
Does not build segments, write base email copy, or score final email quality.
Cannot verify field availability or fill rates without user-provided export data.
Native ESP syntax and template syncing may require platform-specific connectors.

use_cases.title: Protect Lifecycle Campaigns
use_cases.description: Add reliable name, location, and product fallbacks to retention emails without exposing sensitive subscriber data.

use_cases.title: Build Segment Variations
use_cases.description: Define conditional blocks for named customer groups and ensure every subscriber receives valid default content.

use_cases.title: Review Personalization Risk
use_cases.description: Audit empty-field behavior, visible PII, and unsupported promotional claims before template assembly.

prompt_templates.title: Add Safe Merge Tags
prompt_templates.prompt: Personalize this existing email using these export columns: [columns]. Map each tag, add a natural fallback, and show the empty-field render.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a small set of personalization fields.

prompt_templates.title: Build Segment Variations
prompt_templates.prompt: Create conditional content for these named segments: [segments]. Use the supplied creative and include a valid catch-all branch for every block.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate campaign with several audience variations.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Fallbacks and PII
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this personalized template: [template]. Test empty values, review all visible fields for PII, and list safer substitutions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced safety review before rendering or approval.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Personalization Specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Using [creative], [segment map], [columns], and [fill rates], produce the tag map, conditional rules, safety audit, claims review, and handoff summary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Complete campaign specification with measured coverage data.

output_examples.input: A welcome email uses first name and city. Available columns are first_name and city, and both may be empty.
output: First name maps to first_name and falls back to "there," producing "Hi there," when empty.
City maps to city and falls back to "your area" when empty.
The safety audit finds no blank greeting or orphaned punctuation.

output_examples.input: Champions receive a loyalty offer, at-risk customers receive a win-back offer, and all other customers receive the base offer.
output: Champions receive the approved loyalty variation.
At-risk customers receive the approved win-back variation.
The catch-all branch renders the base offer for every unmatched subscriber.
The audit flags any variation that lacks approved claim wording.

best_practices: Provide exact column names and measured fill rates before defining important conditions.
Use a natural fallback for every tag and a catch-all branch for every conditional block.
Review visible fields for PII and use only approved promotional claims.
anti_patterns: Do not invent missing columns, segments, fill rates, or subscriber attributes.
Do not render raw subscriber rows, contact details, precise addresses, or order identifiers.
Do not use a bare tag when an empty value breaks grammar or changes an offer.

faq.question: What inputs does this skill require?
faq.answer: Provide existing email copy, named segments or export columns, campaign mode, and fill rates when available.

faq.question: Can this skill create customer segments?
faq.answer: No. It applies personalization to existing segments and asks for missing segment definitions.

faq.question: Does it write the base email copy?
faq.answer: No. It adds merge tags, conditional variations, fallbacks, and safety controls to supplied copy.

faq.question: How does it handle missing values?
faq.answer: Every tag receives a natural fallback, and every conditional block receives a valid catch-all branch.

faq.question: How does it protect subscriber privacy?
faq.answer: It works from columns and aggregate fill rates, blocks sensitive visible fields, and avoids repeating raw subscriber data.

faq.question: Can it sync templates to an email platform?
faq.answer: The core skill produces a specification. Platform syncing is optional and may require a compatible connector.
